author: Huawei
description:
IT infrastructure is becoming more complex.

Rising costs, skills shortages, and multi-vendor complexity are creating hidden challenges for businesses.

In this episode of #TransformTalks, Sascha Held, CEO of IT-Formation, shares why reducing complexity and building trusted technology partnerships are essential for stronger, future-ready infrastructure.
